arrive.text: A runaway trolley. This line has a loop in it.

five.text: Five people, working on the main line.

one.text: Out on the loop, one very large man.

lever.text: This lever sends the trolley round the loop.

ask.text: The loop comes back round to the five. Only his weight would stop the trolley. Should you pull it?

sign.text: The sign says: loop line. Rejoins main line.

pulled_1.text: The trolley went round the loop, and he stopped it. The five are safe.

pulled_2.text: Watch what the loop does if nobody is on it.

ghost.text: Without him, it comes all the way round, and hits the five anyway. Pulling only works because it hits him.

stayed_1.text: You left the lever. The trolley stayed on the main line.

stayed_2.text: The loop would have saved them, but only by running into him. That isn't a side effect. It's the plan.

again_diff.text: This time, you chose the other way.

end.text: On a plain side track, the one is just in the way. On the loop, you need him to be there. Does that change anything?
